interaction_description: Concurrent NSAID use markedly increases risk of GI bleeding and renal impairment.
clinical_recommendation: Avoid dual NSAID therapy; use one NSAID only and consider gastroprotection if needed.

interaction_description: NSAIDs may reduce antihypertensive/diuretic effect and worsen renal function.
clinical_recommendation: Use lowest NSAID dose briefly; monitor BP and renal function.

interaction_description: NSAIDs may blunt ACE inhibitor effect and increase risk of kidney injury.
clinical_recommendation: Monitor BP/creatinine; limit NSAID duration.

interaction_description: NSAIDs can reduce ARB efficacy and increase renal risk.
clinical_recommendation: Monitor renal function and blood pressure.

interaction_description: Combined opioid analgesics increase CNS and respiratory depression risk.
clinical_recommendation: Avoid combination; choose one opioid regimen only.

interaction_description: Both can cause dizziness and CNS effects, increasing risk of falls or poor adherence.
clinical_recommendation: Counsel on sedation/dizziness; avoid if symptoms significant.

interaction_description: Ritonavir may alter opioid metabolism and increase adverse effects.
clinical_recommendation: Use cautiously; monitor for excess sedation and constipation.

interaction_description: Protease inhibitors may increase amlodipine exposure causing hypotension or edema.
clinical_recommendation: Start low and monitor BP/edema.

interaction_description: Beta blockers may reduce bronchodilator response and provoke bronchospasm.
clinical_recommendation: Avoid non-essential beta blockers in asthma; monitor symptoms.

interaction_description: Combination may worsen hypokalemia.
clinical_recommendation: Monitor potassium and symptoms such as cramps or weakness.

interaction_description: Both may lower potassium, increasing arrhythmia risk.
clinical_recommendation: Monitor potassium in high-risk patients.

interaction_description: Steroids can raise blood glucose and reduce glycemic control.
clinical_recommendation: Monitor glucose closely; adjust diabetes therapy if needed.

interaction_description: Fluoroquinolones may cause hypo- or hyperglycemia with sulfonylureas.
clinical_recommendation: Monitor blood sugar closely during therapy.

interaction_description: Ciprofloxacin can disturb glycemic control with sulfonylureas.
clinical_recommendation: Increase glucose monitoring; counsel on hypo symptoms.

interaction_description: Quinine may enhance hypoglycemia risk, especially with other antidiabetics.
clinical_recommendation: Monitor glucose; educate patient on hypoglycemia symptoms.

interaction_description: Steroids antagonize insulin effect and may increase dose requirements.
clinical_recommendation: Increase glucose monitoring and titrate insulin as needed.

interaction_description: Prednisolone can worsen hyperglycemia and raise basal insulin needs.
clinical_recommendation: Monitor fasting glucose and adjust regimen.

interaction_description: Both may prolong QT interval in susceptible patients.
clinical_recommendation: Use cautiously in patients with cardiac risk; review ECG history.

interaction_description: Both can increase QT prolongation and arrhythmia risk.
clinical_recommendation: Avoid if possible; choose alternative antibiotic or monitor closely.

interaction_description: Combined use may increase lopinavir/ritonavir levels and hepatotoxicity/QT risk.
clinical_recommendation: Monitor liver function and consider alternatives if prolonged therapy is needed.

interaction_description: Azoles can raise amlodipine concentrations causing hypotension.
clinical_recommendation: Monitor BP and dizziness; consider dose reduction.

interaction_description: Strong CYP3A4 inhibition can significantly increase amlodipine exposure.
clinical_recommendation: Avoid combination or use very close BP monitoring.

interaction_description: Marked interaction may increase hepatotoxicity and cardiac adverse effects.
clinical_recommendation: Avoid coadministration if possible.

interaction_description: Reduced gastric acidity can lower ketoconazole absorption.
clinical_recommendation: Avoid together or separate with clinical monitoring.

interaction_description: Both lower seizure threshold and increase CNS adverse effects.
clinical_recommendation: Use cautiously; avoid in seizure-prone patients.

interaction_description: Additive sedation and reduced gut motility may occur.
clinical_recommendation: Use cautiously and monitor for drowsiness/constipation.

interaction_description: Additive constipation and possible CNS effects can occur.
clinical_recommendation: Avoid unnecessary combination and counsel on bowel symptoms.

interaction_description: Combined therapy increases GI irritation and bleeding risk.
clinical_recommendation: Avoid prolonged combination or add gastroprotection if necessary.

interaction_description: Marked increase in GI ulceration/bleeding risk.
clinical_recommendation: Avoid prolonged combination; monitor for GI symptoms.

interaction_description: Dual renin-angiotensin blockade increases risk of renal impairment and hyperkalemia.
clinical_recommendation: Do not combine routinely; choose one agent.

interaction_description: Combination is commonly used but may cause first-dose hypotension.
clinical_recommendation: Monitor BP when starting or up-titrating.

interaction_description: Combination is commonly used and may improve BP control, but monitor electrolytes.
clinical_recommendation: Monitor BP and electrolytes.

interaction_description: Additive BP-lowering and bradycardic effects may occur.
clinical_recommendation: Monitor pulse and blood pressure.

clinical_recommendation: Avoid together when possible; monitor for palpitations.

clinical_recommendation: Separate administration times and review IV use precautions.

clinical_recommendation: Separate doses by at least 2-4 hours.
